minutes.headline: Finance Committee heard police and fire FY23 budget presentations; no budget votes, only minutes approved.
minutes.summary: The committee heard the police chief's and fire chief's FY23 budget presentations, including new requests (part-time clerk, motorcycle lease, K-9 replacement, cruiser, F-150 truck) and a staffing plan for paramedic coverage. Members questioned the F-150 truck need most closely. The town manager gave updates on Monty Tech, Chapter 90 and dispatch assessments. Minutes of two prior meetings were approved and the meeting adjourned.

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of February 17th and 24th

budget_items.what_was_said: Monty Tech's preliminary assessment is almost identical to the town manager's preliminary budget number, slightly favorable to the town.
MassDOT's Chapter 90 allotment for fiscal 23 is a reimbursement-type aid, a small change from the current year.
Dispatch budget finalized below the preliminary number, a percentage increase over last year.
The police presentation consolidates salaries across lines and differs from the town manager's line-item layout; members asked whether the totals reconcile and were told all numbers are included.
Using county safekeeping lets the police reduce lock-up cost, with part reallocated to a part-time clerk.
Contractual incentives are about eight percent of the budget.
figures_as_heard: two hundred and six thousand dollars

budget_items.what_was_said: Chair asked whether additional training money could be spent; chief said yes.

budget_items.topic: Police purchase of services and supplies
budget_items.what_was_said: Services and supplies are modest; a motorcycle lease and a K-9 increase are included.
Vehicle maintenance, services, supplies and fuel lines were itemized for a 13-vehicle fleet.
Request to add money to the budget for the comfort dog.
Replacement K-9 cost was broken down by breeder quote, training, kennel and equipment.
A new hybrid cruiser is estimated with base price plus upfitting, with concern that prices may rise.
The truck request drew skepticism from the chair about cost and fleet size; the chief argued current hybrid SUVs are not rated for the trailers.
Selling three used vehicles brought in revenue.
The chief said the unfunded cost of the reserve officer bridge academy training exceeded the amount presented earlier.
Includes one additional career firefighter/paramedic (year five of the staffing plan), continued paramedic training, and small above-target increases.
Personnel board approved higher rates for advanced EMTs and paramedics; to be absorbed in on-call salary line, pending town meeting.
Brush truck chassis replacement deferred a year because reliable numbers could not be obtained; replacement estimated roughly.
Grants for protective equipment and emergency management preparedness.
Last engine purchase cost and ambulances rising yearly; stabilization fund must keep being funded.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee heard the police chief's FY23 budget presentation, which consolidates salaries differently from the town manager's line-item layout.
The police chief described new requests: a part-time clerk, a motorcycle lease, a K-9 increase, a replacement K-9 and a new hybrid cruiser.
The Fire Department presented its FY23 budget; members questioned the F-150 truck request most closely.
The town manager reported Monty Tech's preliminary assessment is nearly identical to the preliminary budget number, and gave Chapter 90 and dispatch updates.
No budget votes were taken; the committee approved prior minutes and tabled capital planning questions until the town manager's March 10th update.

why_it_matters: These presentations set out what the police and fire departments want in the FY23 town budget, which residents vote on at Town Meeting and pay for through the tax bill.
Police salaries were presented in a different layout from the town manager's, so whether the totals match is a question the committee raised and was answered only verbally.
watch_next: The town manager's capital planning update on March 10th, when the tabled capital questions return.
The March 17th agenda, which is to include a draft of the committee's warrant letter.
